cc_updates.body: Added X-Claude-Code-Session-Id header, fixed --resume failures, improved prompt cache hit rates, and addressed various UI/performance issues.
Added MCP environment variables, conditional hooks, timestamp markers, deep link expansion to 5000 chars, and fixed multiple plugin/MCP issues.
Introduced PowerShell tool preview, added TaskCreated hook, expanded deep link support, and resolved issues with plugin management and session stability.
Added managed-settings drop-in directory, transcript search functionality, CwdChanged/FileChanged hooks, and fixed numerous terminal/UI rendering issues.
Introduced --bare flag for scripted calls, --channels permission relay, fixed concurrent session re-authentication, and resolved voice mode connection issues.
Added rate_limits field to statusline, inline plugin marketplace sourcing, effort frontmatter support, and improved file autocomplete performance in large repos.
Added --console flag for API authentication, fixed voice mode WebSocket failures, improved non-streaming API fallback, and enhanced startup memory usage.
Implemented line-by-line response streaming, added StopFailure hook, enhanced plugin data persistence, and fixed sandbox and git-related issues.
Increased token limits for Opus/Sonnet models, added allowRead sandbox setting, fixed --resume truncation, and optimized session loading performance.
Added MCP elicitation support, new Elicitation/ElicitationResult hooks, --name CLI flag, worktree sparse checkout, and /effort slash command.
